covenants.name: Total Leverage Ratio
covenants.quote: Total Leverage Ratio, defined as consolidated total indebtedness to consolidated EBITDA, shall not exceed 3.50 to 1.00

covenants.name: Senior Secured Leverage Ratio
covenants.quote: Senior Secured Leverage Ratio, defined as the ratio of consolidated senior secured net indebtedness to consolidated EBITDA, shall not exceed 3.00 to 1.00

covenants.name: Interest Coverage Ratio
covenants.quote: Interest Coverage Ratio, defined as consolidated EBITDA to cash consolidated interest expense, shall not be less than 3.00 to 1.00

covenants.name: Total Net Leverage Ratio
covenants.quote: Total Net Leverage Ratio which, on a rolling twelve-month basis, is defined as consolidated net indebtedness to consolidated EBITDA, is greater than 3.50 to 1.00
